_doc.what: Layer C's labelled fixtures. Each records similarity values for one class, in the embedding space its threshold compares. Validated by _calibration_record.load_fixtures.

shape.class: one of: bullseye, handle-words, family-neighbour, off-axis, rejection-target, retired-precedent
shape.form: query (embedded as a query, read through MCP surface_decisions) or draft (embedded as a document, read through conflict.gather_candidates); the space follows from the form and is never authored
shape.targets: Harbor slugs, possibly empty (an off-axis query has no right answer)
shape.negatives: Harbor slugs recorded as hard negatives
shape.measure: target (each target's value) or top_live (the top live hit's value, the band's input)
shape.exclude: optional: slugs flagged as the draft's own node and left out of every margin
shape.notes: one line: why this label holds

_doc.rejection-target: Targets are slugs today. That class's targets are rejected items, not decisions; 1c extends the target shape for it.
